name: autopia
description: Verified HTTP API behavior, injected at the moment it matters: before an agent's first call to a covered host (api.github.com, registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org, api.anthropic.com, ...) and available as MCP tools for the error path.

autopia_key.title: Autopia API key
autopia_key.description: Per-user key for the Autopia compendium server (starts with ak_). Used by the PreToolUse hook and the MCP server. Ask the maintainer for one; see the plugin README.

autopia_url.title: Autopia MCP URL
autopia_url.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint of the compendium server. Leave empty for the hosted default.
